title: Tunisian Lamb Tagine with Japanese Twist
description: A fusion of Japanese flavors with traditional Tunisian ingredients, this lamb tagine is a unique and delicious meal option.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb slices and cook until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the cumin, red pepper flakes, and soy sauce to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped apricots, browned lamb, and chicken broth to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
